Maya (CS): Quick heads-up — SierraHealth onboarding flagged a latency SLO miss for last Thurs night window. Need customer-facing report + credit calc by EOD.
Clara (Eng): Ack. Can you paste the observed windows and SLO numbers? I'll pull the dashboard visuals.
Maya (CS): SLO: p95 latency < 300ms (rolling 30d), uptime 99.9% monthly. Observed: p95 spiked to ~620ms 2025-11-13 02:00-04:30 UTC, uptime for billing period shows 99.22% (so below 99.9).
Ben (SRE): Sounds like autoscale didn't spin up fast enough for a traffic burst. I saw queue buildup on the rtx pool at 02:05.
Maya (CS): Customer asked: how much credit do they get? We have the contract formula: credit = max(0, (SLA_target - observed_uptime) / SLA_target) * monthly_fee capped at 100%.
Maya (CS): Example calc I ran: ((0.999 - 0.9922) / 0.999) * $18,000 = approx $126. That sound right?
Ben (SRE): Quick sanity: (0.999 - 0.9922) = 0.0068. 0.0068/0.999 ≈ 0.0068068. *18000 ≈ $122.52. So your order-of-magnitude is fine. Use our precise calc for the report.
Clara (Eng): I'll export the 30d p95 chart and a small timeline of the spike. Want me to include the autoscale events as annotations?
Maya (CS): Yes please — timeline + root cause note. Keep language customer-friendly. Draft blurb below, feedback welcome:
Maya (CS): "We observed a brief traffic surge on Nov 13 that caused response times to exceed your agreed p95 threshold. Our investigation shows autoscaling lagged during the peak; we've updated autoscaling configuration to reduce cold-starts and will monitor. Per the SLA, your calculated credit for the period is $122.52. We're ready to apply this credit to your next invoice or issue a one-time refund — which do you prefer?"
Clara (Eng): +1. I'll attach the timeline link and the exported PNG.
Ben (SRE): FYI ops changes: increased scale_up_rate from 2 -> 4, reduced target_cpu from 65% -> 55% for the rtx pool. Deployed at 2025-11-14 09:12 UTC. I can paste the config diff if needed.
Ben (SRE): Config diff snippet:
```
- scale_up_rate: 2
- target_cpu: 65
+ scale_up_rate: 4
+ target_cpu: 55
```
Maya (CS): Perfect. Need a final approval for the wording before I send to the customer. Also will ask if they want credit applied or invoice adjustment.
Clara (Eng): +1 from eng. Please include a short graph, the exact credit calc line, and the remediation steps.
Ben (SRE): +1 from infra. I'll also add that we've scheduled a follow-up runbook review with oncall next week.
Maya (CS): Action items: 1) Clara export chart + timeline (deliverable: PNG + link) 2) Ben paste config diff and confirm monitoring alerts 3) Maya send email and capture customer preference. ETA: EOD PST.
OpsBot: Scheduled reminder set for #customer-success at 2025-11-14 16:00 PST.
Maya (CS): Thanks team :raised_hands: — I'll post the outgoing email draft in a thread and tag you both for a final quick sign-off before sending.
